title: Elodie and the Garden
author: Freya Oyelaran
blurb: Coral Underhill, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
